---
title: "About Me"
---

I am currently a student in the Mathematical Sciences program at [Universiti Brunei Darussalam](https://ubd.edu.bn/), temporarily residing in Brunei while my permanent home is in Mataram, West Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia. My research focuses on spatial modeling for Gaussian data, where I explore the spatial structure of neighborhood areas using Bayesian hierarchical models, particularly **Conditional Autoregressive (CAR)** models.

To enhance my research capabilities, I am actively developing my skills in `R` programming and `Stan`, leveraging these tools to implement and analyze complex statistical models. Additionally, I have expanded my expertise to include web data scraping using the `rvest` package in `R`, which allows me to efficiently collect and process data for my research.
